item.title: [翻译] Lenny's Newsletter: 如何打造穿越任何时代的公司
item.description:
标签: #精益创业 #公司治理 #基业长青 #企业使命

摘要: 《精益创业》作者Eric Ries在新书《Incorruptible》中揭示，成功企业往往受“财务引力”影响而走向平庸腐败，唯有通过建立保护核心使命的治理结构，才能避免创始人出局与价值侵蚀，打造真正跨越时代的公司。

原标题: How to build a company that withstands any era | Eric Ries, Lean Startup author

How to build a company that withstands any era | Eric Ries, Lean Startup author

如何打造一家经得起任何时代考验的公司 | 《精益创业》作者 Eric Ries

Eric Ries is the author of The Lean Startup, a book that reshaped how a generation of founders think about building companies. His new book, Incorruptible, explains how successful companies are destroyed by failing to protect what makes them valuable, and how to change it.

Eric Ries 是《精益创业》（The Lean Startup）一书的作者，这本书重塑了一代创始人对创业的看法。他的新书《不可腐蚀》（Incorruptible）解释了成功的公司如何因未能保护其核心价值而走向毁灭，以及如何改变这一命运。

Listen on YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts

在 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple Podcasts 上收听

In our in-depth conversation, we discuss:

在本次深度对话中，我们讨论了：

  • Why 80% of venture-backed founders are ousted within three years of going public
  • The governance structures that protect companies like Anthropic, Costco, and Novo Nordisk
  • The simple legal filing that takes two pages and could save your company
  • Financial gravity: why successful companies predictably get corrupted into mediocrity
  • Why mission-aligned companies like Anthropic reap major benefits from protecting their mission through governance
  • Why success won’t protect you—it instead makes you a bigger target

• 为什么80%的风投支持（venture-backed）创始人在公司上市三年内被罢免
• 保护 Anthropic、Costco 和 Novo Nordisk 等公司的治理结构（governance structures）
• 一份仅需两页的简单法律文件如何拯救你的公司
• 财务引力（Financial gravity）：为什么成功的公司注定会堕落为平庸
• 为什么像 Anthropic 这样使命一致（mission-aligned）的公司通过治理保护其使命能获得巨大收益
• 为什么成功不会保护你——反而会让你成为更大的目标

Brought to you by:

本期内容由以下赞助商呈现：

Vanta—Automate compliance, manage risk, and accelerate trust with AI

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 引述安德鲁·奎因
item.description:
标签: #造轮子 #编程学习 #实践学习

摘要: Andrew Quinn 认为，担心自己的实现早已被更优方案取代而不敢“造轮子”是一种陷阱。他指出，在大多数领域只需重新发明少量轮子，这种带着问题的实践远比被动学习更能快速将你推向真正的技术前沿。

原标题: Quoting Andrew Quinn

Quoting Andrew Quinn

One could say in the first quarter-century of my life, that while I was always fascinated by programming, I could never overcome the guilt of not really knowing whether the tool I am building right now isn’t already superceded by some much better implementation someone else has already written 30 or 40 years ago; I could write a TSV-aware search and replace, or I could find out aboutawkand solve that entire class of problems in one fell swoop, for example. My central conceit is thatthis is a trap. Youneedto reinvent a couple of wheels to get to the edge of what we know about wheel-making, not a thousand wheels, and not zero; probably four or five is sufficient in most domains, maybe closer to twenty or thirty in the most epistemically rigorous and developed fields like mathematics or computer science. Each wheel you reinvent, and every directed question you ask along the way, will propel you faster to the true frontier than that same amount of time spend in idle study, or even five times that amount.

可以说，在我人生的前四分之一世纪里，尽管我始终对 programming（编程） 充满热忱，却始终无法摆脱这样一种愧疚感：我永远无法确定，自己此刻正在构建的工具，是否早在三四十年前就已被别人写出过更好的实现所取代；例如，我可以写一个支持 TSV（制表符分隔值） 的查找替换工具，或者我也可以去了解 awk，然后一举解决整类问题。我的核心观点是，这是一个陷阱。你需要亲自重新发明几个轮子，才能抵达当下轮子制造技术的边缘——不是一千个，也不是零个；在大多数领域，四五个大概就足够了，而在数学或 computer science（计算机科学） 这类认识论最严谨、发展最成熟的领域，可能接近二三十个。你重新发明的每一个轮子，以及沿途提出的每一个针对性问题，都会比将同样长的时间——甚至是五倍的时间——花在空泛的学习上，更能推动你快速抵达真正的前沿。

—Andrew Quinn, footnote on Replacing a 3 GB SQLite database with a 10 MB FST (finite state transducer) binary

——Andrew Quinn（安德鲁·奎因），脚注出自《Replacing a 3 GB SQLite database with a 10 MB FST（finite state transducer，有限状态转换器） binary》
